name: Galen's Escape
summary: In the Fallow Sanctuary, Galen Goodward calls for help as creatures close around him. He offers a great treasure from his camp north of Stonard.

sections.title: A Plea for Rescue
sections.body: Galen Goodward calls out from the Fallow Sanctuary, afraid the creatures around him will eat him. He promises a great treasure to anyone who gets him out. It lies in a strongbox at his camp in the swamp north of Stonard. Only Galen knows the trick to open it, and he will teach it to whoever rescues him.

sections.title: At the Strongbox
sections.body: At Galen's camp, black resin blocks the strongbox's keyhole. Galen told you of a latch hidden beneath the box. You find it with a quick search, and flipping it opens the strongbox.

faq.answer: Galen Goodward is held in the Fallow Sanctuary, where he fears the creatures will eat him. He offers a great treasure to anyone who helps him escape.
Galen's camp lies in the swamp north of Stonard, in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Why can't the strongbox be opened in the usual way?
faq.answer: Black resin blocks the strongbox's keyhole, and Galen knows a hidden latch beneath it. He promises to teach the trick to anyone who helps him escape.
